pairflow's presentation discipline solves the same 'make owner decisions cheap' problem via message rules rather than a session format.

metaConcepts.name: The environment survey
metaConcepts.summary: Before building anything that touches the outside world, empirically test what the actual runtime environment can and cannot do, and log the answer as a recorded decision.

confpipeline.manifestation: A standing build item, run twice with opposite outcomes (two external sources, one interactive, one headless).

related.note: pairflow:M11's authoring-time sibling rule ('substrate claims are PROBED, not presumed') is the same instinct embedded in the mutation-probe mechanism — related, not merged.

metaConcepts.name: Projection, not invention
metaConcepts.summary: Once sources are ratified, writing a downstream work spec is selecting and compiling already-decided content; nothing semantically new may be invented at spec-writing time.

pairflow.manifestation: The plan orders and scopes, the task packet projects, the gates verify; the packet template itself marks operative material as 'projection, not invention'.

related.note: The write-time sibling of the divergence-stop discipline: both keep semantics born only in the ratified plane.
The runbook-adds-no-why rule is a weaker relative at the how/why boundary.

metaConcepts.name: Push constraints down the ladder: environment > data > prose
metaConcepts.summary: A constraint enforced by the environment (types, schemas, linters, fixtures) costs zero context and fails locally, beating data, which beats an in-context prose rule; new rules are admitted mechanize-first.

pairflow.localTitle: Push constraints down the ladder: environment > data > in-context rule
pairflow.manifestation: The in-context budget is the scarce resource; admission bias prefers mechanize, then extend an existing lens duty, then new prose — a rule shaped by the economics of LLM context.

related.note: PRC-13 demands enforcement exists; this orders WHERE enforcement should live. Confpipeline's checks-enforce-prose has no explicit ladder or context-budget argument.

metaConcepts.name: The convergence ramp is itself the coherence test
metaConcepts.summary: Capability grows in small coherent increments, and the growth path doubles as a test of the design: if a new capability slots in as a small branch, the abstraction holds; if it forces a tear-up, the earlier model was wrong.

pairflow.localTitle: The convergence ramp is itself the coherence test
pairflow.manifestation: One coherent capability per level of the kernel rebuild; the design-method playbook carries the algorithm-level form of the same test.

related.note: Both are growth laws, but concept-first phasing orders altitude while this one uses increment-fit as a falsifier of the model.

metaConcepts.name: Tier-0 scoping: machines check hard deterministic facts, never semantics from prose
metaConcepts.summary: Fully automatic gates verify only shape, existence, reference resolution, and equality over declared data; judging the meaning of prose stays with reviewers — a line that settles every future 'should the lint check this?' dispute.

pairflow.localTitle: Tier 0 checks hard deterministic facts over declared data, never semantics from prose
pairflow.manifestation: The dispute-settling boundary between machine gates and lens duties in the v3 gate suite.

related.note: Project S's advisory principle draws a similar machine/judgment authority line but resolves judgment to warnings, while pairflow routes it to reviewer duties; considered for merging and kept apart.
Round zero (deterministic checks first, judgment rounds after) is the same line drawn in time; owned by the mechanism family.

metaConcepts.name: Teachability is a gate co-equal with correctness
metaConcepts.summary: An artifact that is technically right but unlearnable fails its acceptance gate exactly as a wrong one would; a fresh reader must demonstrably understand it before anything is accepted.

project-s.localTitle: Teachability is a gate co-equal with correctness
project-s.manifestation: A fresh-reader check is part of every level's and every tour chapter's acceptance, never deferred as debt — unique to the corpus-as-teaching-instrument nature of project-s.

related.note: P14 is what makes this gate-able: blind measurement of comprehension.

metaConcepts.name: Comprehension is measured, never recall; the instrument is blind
metaConcepts.summary: Validation instruments are deliberately deprived of the inputs that would let them pattern-match: the test reader is kept from the notes and pass markers, and questions are unanswerable by echoing the artifact's wording.

project-s.localTitle: Comprehension is measured, never recall; the instrument is blind
project-s.manifestation: Question-bank writing principle plus notes-blind fresh-reader arm; derives from P5 (PRC-27).

related.note: Shares the anti-fake-success spirit of able-to-fail instruments, but measures human/reader understanding rather than code guards; deliberately not merged.

metaConcepts.name: The model is a conversation basis and sizing instrument first
metaConcepts.summary: The corpus exists first to enable good conversations and an honest size/effort estimate; it counts as an implementation spec only where actually validated, with the MVP cut carried as a column, not a retro.

project-s.localTitle: The model is a conversation basis and sizing instrument first, an implementation spec only where validated
project-s.manifestation: Carried into every mvp column, the debt map's seeds, the ledger's MVP-cut view, and the tour's rule to simplify only along the MVP-cut axis.

metaConcepts.name: Fragmented model space with stable IDs
metaConcepts.summary: Knowledge lives in many small single-responsibility files cross-referenced by permanent ID codes rather than prose restatement, so edits stay local and safe.

confpipeline.manifestation: S-n/R-n/ABS-n and vocabulary slugs as the addressing scheme of the whole model tree.

related.note: The addressing/granularity sibling of one-authority-per-fact.

Project S practices the identical ID-ledger pattern (INV-*/ABS-*/S/DA + referential-integrity gate G1) but anchors it in artifacts and gates, not a principle; those items belong to the artifact/gate families, so this stays a single-project principle anchor. Pairflow's IC-*/PI-*/C-n rows are the same practice (A15).

metaConcepts.notes: Concept-level presence is arguably universal via artifacts; kept unique in the principle family to avoid claiming what the artifact family owns. Cross-family reviewers should reconcile.

metaConcepts.name: Loud failure over silent wrongness
metaConcepts.summary: A critical step either runs or fails visibly — never skips in a way nobody can prove; swallowed exceptions and caught-and-dropped errors are the named enemy.

confpipeline.manifestation: Anchored in rule R-6 with a named exhibit, policed by a dedicated silent-failure-hunting review duty, and realized in the G7 phase-tool exit contracts.

related.note: The coverage-closure meta is the accounting cousin; this one also covers runtime error behavior.

Project S's check suite carries the 'never fake-green, never fake-red' discipline as a code header, and pairflow's process forbids silent stops/patches — the spirit recurs, but neither anchors it as a principle.

metaConcepts.name: Every rule earns its place at this project's size
metaConcepts.summary: The process is a deliberate downsizing of a heavier method; any added rule must state the defect class it prevents, its plausibility, and its weight cost against the stated threat model.

confpipeline.localTitle: Every rule earns its place at this project's size
confpipeline.manifestation: Operationalized by the proportionality gate in the review briefs; the explicit self-awareness of being a slimmed-down pairflow-descendant method.

related.note: Consumes the stated threat model as its measuring stick.
Pairflow's retirement-with-catch-tally is the temporal version: rules must keep earning their place; related, not the same admission-time bias.

metaConcepts.name: Design artifacts graduate into runtime config
metaConcepts.summary: Design documents are written so they can later serve directly as the running system's configuration, making ID discipline and machine checks pay twice — once at design time, once in production.

confpipeline.localTitle: Design artifacts graduate into runtime config
confpipeline.manifestation: Realized graduation on record: config/taxonomy.yaml, with entity contracts parsed live by the validation scripts.

metaConcepts.name: Supervised, never autonomous, at runtime
metaConcepts.summary: The running system never contacts an outside person on its own: every outgoing item needs per-item human approval, no autonomous outbound flow exists, and decision-requiring review findings escalate to the owner.

confpipeline.manifestation: R-12 plus ABS-4 deferral with per-flow graduation triggers; the only project whose product itself acts toward external humans, hence the runtime supervision principle.

related.note: The judgment-boundary meta covers decision competence; this covers outbound action authority — related halves of human control, not the same block.

metaConcepts.name: Model-agnostic workflow steps
metaConcepts.summary: Which AI model runs a step is per-step configuration, never baked into the workflow, so every step stays swappable to a different or cheaper model later.

confpipeline.manifestation: R-14, interview-labeled and accepted; both accepted workflow specs consume it and the queued agent-layer design item builds on it.

related.note: Pairflow also treats model choice as explicit revisable configuration (arm-pin table, per-chapter tier experiments M12), but for review reproducibility rather than runtime swappability; considered and not merged.

metaConcepts.name: The declared autonomy trajectory (a dated position on the trust dial)
metaConcepts.summary: An explicit, dated self-description of how far the loop is currently trusted to run alone, with named stages and the criteria for moving to the next — the calibration point every autonomy rule is measured against.

pairflow.manifestation: Calibration closed with the ch7 pilot; measurement runs autonomous packets with post-hoc detector-miss audits; chaining is the declared future with a stated concreteness criterion.

related.note: 'supervised, never autonomous, at runtime' with per-flow graduation triggers is a declared autonomy stance too — but a static runtime boundary, not a staged trajectory of the development loop itself; not merged, though the family resemblance is real
the autonomy-proportional-to-contract-density principle this state calibrates

metaConcepts.notes: Kept unique on the err-toward-not-merging rule; if the synthesis wants a looser 'declared autonomy posture' block, confpipeline P15 is the candidate second member (project-s has none — everything is owner-gated with no declared ramp).

metaConcepts.name: The frozen prior-cycle quarry
metaConcepts.summary: The process's own previous output kept whole and frozen — simultaneously a harvest source, an archive, and a check input — with no writer and therefore no gate: failure inverts from silent carry-over to loud missing-file.

project-s.manifestation: The whole first-cycle tree renamed to a sibling and frozen; 'a quarry, NOT a base'; exempt from the checked scan surface; G7 reads it as a check source.

related.note: frozen upstream INPUT vs frozen prior OUTPUT — same read-only posture, different provenance; deliberately not merged
the debt map is the instrument that drains the quarry's live obligations
supersede-forward onto an oracle branch ('no history surgery') creates the same frozen-predecessor state at smaller scale — the nearest pairflow relative
the deliberate-pull migration is the act that created this state

metaConcepts.notes: A state with an ownership profile rather than a form — kept as its own UNC block because no artifact-anchored concept honestly contains it.
